label: First Way mover is necessary, from PURE_ACT_5 and POTENCY_1 for possible nonexistence
description: Same-witness conditional result, potency route: pure act and B4 give necessity of the first mover. Not a transcription (B4's consequent is potency, not necessity), but B4 is classically equivalent to the target restricted to w, so the route relocates the open question. Establishes no premise. A counterexample to B4 as typed would be a contingent being in POTENCY_1 in no respect; whether such a being is possible is the open B5/receptive-potency question (DISAMB-RECEPTIVE-POTENCY, DISAMB-POTENCY-IN-SUBJECT-VS-IN-ANOTHER).
